digest.component_or_area: tracker store footprint measurement and diagnostics
propositions: Operators need a reproducible, layered report separating Git pack bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes, Git-directory bytes, and whole-clone bytes without conflating these measurement layers.
The measurement command is explicitly opt-in, read-only, and never invoked implicitly from ticket writes, reconciliation, gates, metrics, or CI.

Default mode measures the configured mounted tracker and labels its object database as shared when it is a linked worktree; --fresh-clone creates a temporary unfiltered single-branch clone, measures it, and removes only command-owned temporary state.
The report includes file count, allocation slack, and platform-specific allocation accounting; unsupported metrics are reported as structured unavailable values rather than fabricated zeros.
Size measurements are descriptive only: no threshold, pass/fail classification, baseline mutation, alert, or nonzero exit is caused solely by a large result.
A failed fresh-clone operation (invalid remote or branch) exits nonzero, leaves no success report, and cleans up only command-owned temporary directories.
